refnamediv.refpurpose: Function to install an in-language function into a SilikoEngine

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoEngineInstallFunction function installs the function implementation new_function into object with the in-language name function_name. C code can access the function with SilikoEngineCallFunction and SilikoEngineFetchFunction. SilikoEvaluate uses this mechanism to look up functions in expressions.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoEngineInstallFunction returns true if the installation succeeded, false otherwise.
